name: captcha-bypass
description: Captcha bypass service: OCR / rotate / slide / detect captcha recognition via a remote HTTP service.
long_description: MCP server for captcha-bypass. Provides four captcha tools (ocr, rotate, slide, detect), calling a remote captcha-bypass HTTP service (requires the server URL and optional auth params, configured at install time via user_config).

token.title: 认证令牌 (token)
token.description: 服务端 AUTH_KEYS 中的任一 key（服务启用认证时必填）

timeout.title: 请求超时 (ms)
timeout.description: 单次识别请求的超时毫秒数 (默认 15000)

tools.name: captcha_ocr
tools.description: Recognize text or math formula from captcha images (onnx or ai engine).

tools.name: captcha_rotate
tools.description: Detect rotation angle of captcha images (single/nox/tiktok).

tools.name: captcha_slide
tools.description: Match slider captcha position by comparing slider image with background image.

tools.name: captcha_detect
tools.description: Detect objects in captcha images (YOLO-style detection or Hungarian matching).

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check the remote captcha-bypass service health.
